correctness.rationale: Abel summation gives an exact monotone ceiling series; the rational one-sided discontinuity is exactly the divisor indicator, producing the algebraic endpoint equations. Monotonicity plus irrational continuity exhaust the gaps. Every length-n prefix varies at rational slopes of denominator at most n; the resulting O(n²) intervals have diameter O_ε((1+ε)^(-n)) and force Hausdorff dimension zero. The local gap constant follows by a mean-value theorem with derivatives converging under a geometrically dominated series. Endpoint beta 1 and 2, rational exceptions, and local-versus-global box dimension are all explicit. The standalone exact-fraction/decimal checker passes but is not substituted for these universal arguments.

value.rationale: The 2026 failure-of-typical-periodic-optimization theorem creates a natural need to quantify the size of its exceptional binary beta parameters. Classifying every complement gap, its pair of algebraic endpoints, a zero-dimensional closure, and a locally sharp exponential gap-width law gives substantive, interpretable parameter geometry. The exact rational-slope indexing is reusable and the prefactor distinguishes arithmetic approximants, beyond known qualitative uncountability or zero Lebesgue measure.
